# ContainerStyleExtensions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Fluent chaining extension methods for styling containers. Each method creates a Container element and returns it as IContentContainer, enabling continued chaining: .Padding(10).Border(1).Background(Color.Red)

Namespace `BonniePDF.Fluent`.

## Methods

- [`AlignCenter`](#aligncenter): Centers the content horizontally.
- [`AlignEnd`](#alignend): Aligns content to inline end.
- [`AlignLeft`](#alignleft): Aligns content to the left (default).
- [`AlignRight`](#alignright): Aligns content to the right.
- [`AlignStart`](#alignstart): Aligns content to inline start.
- [`Background`](#background): Sets the background color.
- [`Border`](#border): Sets a uniform border on all sides.
- [`BorderBottom`](#borderbottom): Sets a bottom border.
- [`BorderHorizontal`](#borderhorizontal): Sets horizontal borders (left and right), matching the PaddingHorizontal convention.
- [`BorderLeft`](#borderleft): Sets a left border.
- [`BorderRight`](#borderright): Sets a right border.
- [`BorderTop`](#bordertop): Sets a top border.
- [`BorderVertical`](#bordervertical): Sets vertical borders (top and bottom), matching the PaddingVertical convention.
- [`ContentFromLeftToRight`](#contentfromlefttoright): Sets left-to-right progression for this container and descendants.
- [`ContentFromRightToLeft`](#contentfromrighttoleft): Sets right-to-left progression for this container and descendants.
- [`CornerRadius`](#cornerradius): Sets the corner radius for rounded corners.
- [`CrispEdges`](#crispedges): Renders the container's subtree inside a crisp-edge region: on SVG export, thin axis-aligned strokes/rects (grid/table lines, dividers) snap to the pixel grid instead of being antialiased.
- [`FillHeight`](#fillheight): Takes the body content height left on the current page instead of sizing to content - the middle band of a header / body / footer page.
- [`Height`](#height): Sets a fixed height.
- [`Margin`](#margin): Sets uniform margin on all sides.
- [`MarginBottom`](#marginbottom): Sets bottom margin.
- [`MarginHorizontal`](#marginhorizontal): Sets horizontal margin (left and right).
- [`MarginLeft`](#marginleft): Sets left margin.
- [`MarginRight`](#marginright): Sets right margin.
- [`MarginTop`](#margintop): Sets top margin.
- [`MarginVertical`](#marginvertical): Sets vertical margin (top and bottom).
- [`Padding`](#padding): Sets uniform padding on all sides.
- [`PaddingBottom`](#paddingbottom): Sets bottom padding.
- [`PaddingHorizontal`](#paddinghorizontal): Sets horizontal padding (left and right).
- [`PaddingLeft`](#paddingleft): Sets left padding.
- [`PaddingRight`](#paddingright): Sets right padding.
- [`PaddingTop`](#paddingtop): Sets top padding.
- [`PaddingVertical`](#paddingvertical): Sets vertical padding (top and bottom).
- [`RoundedCorners`](#roundedcorners): Rounds the container's corners and clips its content to that rounded outline.
- [`Size`](#size): Sets a fixed width and height.
- [`Width`](#width): Sets a fixed width.

### `CrispEdges`

```csharp
IContentContainer CrispEdges(IContentContainer c)
```

*static*

Renders the container's subtree inside a crisp-edge region: on SVG export, thin axis-aligned strokes/rects (grid/table lines, dividers) snap to the pixel grid instead of being antialiased. No-op on PDF output. Apply only to axis-aligned content â€” rounded shapes, diagonals, and text want antialiasing.

### `FillHeight`

```csharp
IContentContainer FillHeight(IContentContainer c)
```

*static*

Takes the body content height left on the current page instead of sizing to content - the middle band of a header / body / footer page.

### `RoundedCorners`

```csharp
IContentContainer RoundedCorners(IContentContainer c, float radius)
```

*static*

Rounds the container's corners and clips its content to that rounded outline. Unlike `CornerRadius` â€” which only rounds the background fill and border stroke â€” this masks the child too, so a full-bleed image or any overflowing content is cut to the rounded box. This is the idiomatic way to build rounded image cards and avatars.

```csharp
container.RoundedCorners(12).Image("avatar.png"); container.RoundedCorners(6).Background(ColorPalette.Slate[100]);
```
